text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Be sure to enter your Veteran<n>Umamusume
in many races!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In Daily Races, you can earn monies and<n>
Support Points, among other things.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can only run in these races a set<n>
number of times per day, so make sure<n>to
enter every day.
color_text_info_list: You can only run in these races a set number of times per day

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain Team Trials, where<n>
you can create and compete with a team<n>
of Veteran Umamusume.
